title: Record suspicion date separately from knowledge-of-infraction date
body:
## Summary
The firm confirmed (comments on the FIRM-QA doc, 2026-09-16) that "suspeita de comportamento irregular"
(the art. 352.º início-diligente anchor) and "conhecimento da infração" (the art. 329.º/2 caducidade
anchor) are two distinct dates. The system records only `knowledgeDate` today. Adds `suspicionDate`,
captured at case intake and required whenever the case opens with `flags.hasPreliminaryInquiry`.

Scoping note: `GET .../cases/{caseId}` returns several other nested read types
(`CaseEmployeeReadDto`, `CaseInstructorReadDto`, etc.) not touched by this change — only
`CaseMilestonesReadDto`, the type actually gaining a field, is expanded in full here.
